Specification: This specification models a minimal two-variable state machine over integer variables x and y. The initial state sets x to 0 and y to 1, and the single transition swaps the values of x and y on each step. The file is specifically designed to test the behavior of temporal-property parsing or analysis when boolean operators and temporal operators are mixed, comparing a plain state predicate, a mixed boolean-and-temporal formula, and an explicit invariant written with [].
